subject: general
question: In November 2024, NITI Aayog launched the 'Accelerating Sustainable State Energy Transition (ASSET)' initiative. What is the primary objective of this initiative?

options.text: To promote electric vehicle adoption in urban areas
To develop nuclear energy infrastructure across states
To support states in achieving their renewable energy targets
To enhance energy efficiency in industrial sectors

solution:
The correct answer is __**To support states in achieving their renewable energy targets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Accelerating Sustainable State Energy Transition (ASSET) initiative was launched by **NITI Aayog in November 2024** to promote the transition to clean and sustainable energy across Indian states.
 
• The primary goal of ASSET is to **assist states in achieving their renewable energy targets**, aligning with India's commitment to global climate goals.
 
• The initiative emphasizes supporting states in **policy development, resource allocation, and capacity building** for renewable energy projects.
 
• ASSET aims to enhance collaboration between the central and state governments to facilitate **efficient implementation of renewable energy policies**.
 
• It is also designed to address challenges such as **grid integration, financial constraints, and sustainable energy access** at the state level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Renewable Energy Targets:**

 
 
• India aims to achieve **500 GW of non-fossil fuel-based installed capacity** by 2030 as part of its climate commitments.
 
• The country is focusing on solar, wind, hydropower, and bio-energy to meet these goals.
 
 
 
• **Role of NITI Aayog:**
 
 
• NITI Aayog is the **policy think tank** of the Government of India, responsible for driving sustainable development and innovation.
 
• It has been actively involved in creating frameworks for **energy transitions and climate action**.
 
 
 
• **Grid Integration of Renewable Energy:**
 
 
• Efficient grid integration is critical for ensuring the stability of electricity supply as renewable energy sources are often intermittent.
 
• Technologies such as **energy storage systems and demand response mechanisms** are being explored to address this challenge.
 
 
 
• **India's Global Climate Commitments:**
 
 
• India is a signatory to the **Paris Agreement** and has pledged to reduce its carbon emissions intensity by 33-35% by 2030.
 
• Renewable energy expansion is a key strategy for meeting these commitments.
